summary: Quillon Freight Systems, Inc. is party to a stock purchase agreement with Brightwater Analytics, Inc..

issues.label: liability cap carve-out conflict
issues.description: A later document narrows or removes a carve-out from the limitation of liability, so the cap now covers losses it should not.
issues.expected_finding: a clause extends the limitation of liability to confidentiality breaches, removing the usual carve-out

issues.label: expired notice window
issues.description: A notice or exercise deadline has already passed relative to the dates in the matter.
issues.expected_finding: the termination notice window may already have passed given the term dates, so the client may be locked into the current term

issues.label: uncapped indemnity
issues.description: An indemnity obligation is excluded from any cap, exposing the client to unlimited liability.
issues.expected_finding: the client's indemnity is uncapped, exposing it to unlimited liability

issues.label: change of control consent
issues.description: A counterparty consent right is triggered by the transaction or a change of control and has not been obtained or addressed.
issues.expected_finding: the change of control clause requires the counterparty's prior written consent, which the deal does not address
